name: Khvostov 7G-0X

frame.name: The Right Choice
frame.description: Every seventh bullet from this weapon ricochets to nearby targets.

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.description: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Eyes Up, Guardian
perks.description: Collecting Orbs of Power strengthens this weapon's next several ricochet shots, providing more damage and more bounces between targets.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: "You don't know how long I've been looking for you."

catalyst.name: Khvostov Catalyst
catalyst.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
